snippet.title: Mad Streets - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch as fists, teddy bears, fruit, and more fly in this trailer for Mad Streets. This physics-based multiplayer party brawler game is available now on Stadia, Steam, and Xbox.

Join the students at Gutsford University in Mad Streets. As you battle your way through the streets, you can string together powerful combo moves for massive knockdowns of your opponents, or target specific areas of the body for more precise attacks. As you journey through the mean streets, you can down various rival gangs utilizing various throwable objects, like bins, bats, plates, tables--even other players.
